newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Tatneft '96 dividend 6,000 rbls ord, 10,000 pref.
newsitem.headline: Tatneft '96 dividend 6,000 rbls ord, 10,000 pref.

text.p: Russian regional oil producer AO Tatneft is increasing its dividend to 6,000 roubles per ordinary share with face value of 10,000 roubles for 1996 from 5,000 roubles paid for 1995, Tatneft's market maker IK Solid said on Thursday.
The dividend on preferred shares rises to 10,000 roubles from 6,000 roubles, it said.
Dividend date is May 27. The shareholders' meeting on June 27 is to discuss a proposal for a 100-1 share split, cutting the face value of shares to 100 roubles.
Tatneft is mostly owned by the government of the Russian autonomous republic of Tatarstan and by its workforce.

It has issued American Depositary Shares (ADS) under the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's rule 144A governing private placements of the share surrogates, and also level-one American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) listed on German exchanges RU/ADRS2.
Tatneft was quoted at $81.00 at 0815 GMT on the Russian Trading System, off an early $84.50 and down from $83.10 at Wednesday's close.
